title: 察覺身體變化
checks: 保持穿著與輕微觸碰，不誇大疼痛
手指、呼吸與視線有連續變化
同一辦公室與服裝連戲
只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. A continuous live-action close shot of the same Taiwanese woman in the same rainy Taipei office at night. Preserve her facial identity, shoulder-length black hair, cream blouse and charcoal cardigan. Her right hand rests over the fabric at the upper left side of her chest as pictured. She makes a small careful finger movement over the blouse, then stops. Her brow tightens slightly and she takes a slow breath. During the second half she raises her eyes toward the monitor without moving her hand away, quietly processing the unexpected sensation. The camera makes a slow subtle forward dolly; the near monitor edge shifts relative to the distant rainy window. She stays seated, fully clothed and silent. Natural restrained concern, no exaggerated pain or collapse. Maintain the same cool window light and warm desk accents. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 8.000 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room ambience, restrained clothing rustle and physical sounds synchronized to the visible movements; rain and distant traffic are audible only in the office scenes.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
